The main takeaway from our work is that
SnI(4), unlike SnI(2) and SnBr(4), does not react cleanly with phosphines to form adducts, and that the reactions are more complex and often result in halogen transfer and/or HI elimination.
the reactions of tin(IV)-halides with tertiary phosphines do not necessarily proceed via simple addition of the phosphine to the tin centre.
